building.roofed_area_m2.note: Scaled at ~34 px/m (20.390 m dimension = 699 px; garage internal 5.610 m = 190 px). Ground-floor outline traced including the ALFRESCO (taken as under the main roof, as is usual for a project home; it lies inside the 20.390 m overall dimension) and the PORCH, excluding eaves: ~193 m2 (+/- 5 m2). The 20.39 x 10.10 = 205.9 m2 bounding box is an upper bound and was not used: the rear is narrower (main house right wall ~0.5 m inside the garage and ensuite line; the alfresco is only ~4.6 m of the rear width) and the left wall steps in ~0.4 m at the multi-purpose room. Without the alfresco the figure would be ~178 m2.
